verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack has Stripe documenting who holds the charter: no named partner bank, no statement of the sponsor model, and nothing on what happens to customers if Stripe or the bank fails. The disclosure component (docs-12) only auto-displays compliant disclosure text and does not explain the charter structure. The Evolve Bank hack thread (comm-10) suggests a partner bank only indirectly through community chatter, so neither counts as the product delivering this transparency.

support.subject: As a founder, I know exactly who holds the charter — whether the platform is a bank, a direct program with a named partner bank, or middleware between me and someone else's sponsor — and what happens to my customers if the platform fails
